newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 aluminium imports up 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 aluminium imports up 3.0 pct.

text.p: China's imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials rose 3.0 percent to 634,418 tonnes in 1996 from 615,749 tonnes in the previous year, customs figures showed on Thursday.
Imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials in December alone reached 65,355 tonnes.
China's imports of unwrought aluminium including alloys dropped 5.4 percent to 366,733 tonnes in 1996 compared with the previous year.
Imports of unwrought aluminium including alloys in December alone were 38,725 tonnes.
Imports of alumina were 1.16 million tonnes in 1996. Imports for 1995 were 1.19 million tonnes.
Imports of alumina in December alone were 160,000 tonnes.

China's exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials fell 34.1 percent to 169,170 tonnes in 1996 compared with 256,744 tonnes in the previous year. Exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials alloys were 27,966 tonnes in December alone.
Exports of unwrought aluminium including alloys fell 42.4 percent to 110,053 tonnes in 1996 compared with 1995.
Exports of alumina were 10,000 tonnes in 1996, down by 39.1 percent from a year ago.
There were no exports of alumina in December.
